citation.title: Plasma ion temperature measurements via charge exchange recombination radiation
citation.authors: R. J. Fonck; R. J. Goldston; R. Kaita; D. E. Post

topic: Foundational proposal and demonstration of CES/CXRS for measuring impurity ion temperature and rotation from Doppler-broadened charge-exchange lines
own_question: Can Doppler profiles of low-Z impurity lines excited by charge exchange with beam neutrals give localized ion temperature?
actual_method_and_evidence: PDX ohmic test: a modulated 28 keV diagnostic H0 beam was crossed with a grazing-incidence spectrometer sightline at r=5 cm. He+ 304 Å was observed in third order. Line profiles were built from shot-to-shot scans and fit with Gaussians, using the background line as the instrument function. The reported near-central Ti was 550±200 eV, versus 450±50 eV from passive charge-exchange analysis. The paper also gives modeled line intensities for PDX and TFTR, but no carbon pedestal data, no timing study, and no prediction.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: CES infers impurity ion temperature locally from Doppler widths of charge-exchange-excited lines where a neutral beam crosses a viewing chord, and line shifts can give rotation.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.2 abstract and body; p.3 paragraphs on spatial resolution and rotation
claim_checks.qualification: The measured quantity is impurity-line temperature, not main-ion or electron temperature. The rotation capability is described, not demonstrated here. The demonstration used He+, not C6+.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Reported CES temperature is a fitted spectral-analysis product that depends on the instrument function and photon statistics.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.3-4, Fig. 2 discussion and uncertainty paragraph
claim_checks.qualification: This is a single early low-signal example. Figures were not visually checked.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Beam pulse 20 ms, modulated at 500 Hz. Profiles were accumulated shot-to-shot. The source gives no report latency or arrival times.
validation_if_relevant: Single comparison with passive charge-exchange Ti on one plasma condition. There is no held-out or predictive validation.
forbidden_inferences: CES labels are independent physical truth
applies directly to KSTAR carbon pedestal-top accuracy
main-ion Ti equals the measured impurity temperature
all prior Ti diagnostics are noncausal
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Cite this as the historical and conceptual basis for the CES label in the theory background. It does not provide evidence for the nowcasting method.
